rule.statement: Rule v2 (research/UNBLOCK_ACQUISITION.md; changed from v1 by operator decision 2026-10-29). Promote an arm-E candidate only if, on the controller-only development panel, (1) over the windows its applicability predicate admits, it decides at least 1/10 of the records and at least 19/20 of its decisions are correct, with no execution error and no non-label result; a new candidate that fails precision only through some output labels is first wrapped (adapter label-abstention-v1, forms verbatim) to abstain on each label whose own panel precision is below 19/20, then validated again in a fresh worker; (2) the new library version (approved entries in library order, first decision per record) has panel precision at or above 19/20 and coverage no lower than the current version (v1 required non-decreasing precision); (3) artifact/promotion-evidence :verified-cases: no record the current version labels correctly is lost, and at least one more record is labelled correctly; (4) no reserved or conflicting name and at most 16 preloaded functions. Exact integer arithmetic. Otherwise the candidate is kept as rejected with its reasons and the pin is unchanged.
